messages:
incident-bot: Alert triggered for canary 'prompt-edge-v2' — elevated 5xx (10%) and p95 latency 4.2s. Paging oncall.

sara_oncall: I'm on it, pulling up deploy and flag dashboards.

lee_eng: Seeing rollout metadata — canary routed a slice to experimental /prompt-edge/new-route (kernel-optim v2) at 03:14 UTC.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: canary batch 3/10 applied in us-west-2.

michael_sre: Can we flip the feature flag back to stable immediately? Which FF key controls this?

sara_oncall: FF key is prompt_edge_newroute. I'm preparing kill-switch.

lee_eng: Logs show repeated OOMs in gpu-worker during KV cache warmup, then 504s and 500s for streaming requests. Repro on a local repro with seq_len=1024.

sara_oncall: Flipping prompt_edge_newroute -> OFF now :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Feature flag prompt_edge_newroute set to OFF by sara_oncall.

michael_sre: Observability: start tracing fallback paths and enable emergency routing to stable-route. Also bump temporary autoscale for edge pool.

julie_pm: Any confirmed customer impact? Need list to inform CS.

cs_escalations: Two customers have reported degraded latency and errors: AcmeCorp (high traffic) and FinchAI (sampling). CS pinged both and opened priority cases.

lee_eng: Metrics improving after flag flip — p95 down to ~1.1s, 5xx ~0.5%. Still watching for residual errors.

sara_oncall: Handoff: michael_sre you're the responder for follow-up. I'll write the incident summary and create the ticket.

michael_sre: Ack. Opening INC-2026-814, attaching traces and worker flamegraphs. Will coordinate kernel rollback plan.

julie_pm: Please prepare a short customer-facing note: what happened, mitigation (FF flip + rollback planned), ETA for postmortem. Prioritize AcmeCorp/FinchAI.

cs_escalations: Sending interim update to customers now; offering a follow-up call and postmortem once RCA complete.

lee_eng: Root cause hypothesis: memory-regression in the new kernel path under certain prefix length distributions (KV cache warmup spike). Can reproduce in staging with prefix=long and batch=8.

sara_oncall: Action items: 1) Keep prompt_edge_newroute OFF, 2) Freeze canary and block rollouts, 3) Revert kernel-optim v2 in next canary, 4) Add KV cache backoff and stricter OOM guards, 5) Full postmortem.

michael_sre: Canary freeze applied — blocking further deployments. I'll schedule the revert and coord with infra for a safe redeploy.

deploy-bot: Canary deployments paused by michael_sre.

sara_oncall: Thanks everyone — documenting timeline and next steps in #postmortems. Will tag owners and capture customer comms. :white_check_mark:

lee_eng: Follow-up note for engineers: add a regression test for large-prefix KV warmup and run with kernel-optim v2 before any future rollout.

michael_sre: I'll leave monitoring alerts on for 24h and then re-evaluate thresholds. Oncall remains assigned to me for follow-ups.

sara_oncall: Closing this paging thread — incident in mitigation state.
